claim: E_LIF and E_GP130_STAT3 are currently BIOLOGICALLY_COLLAPSED and should be reclassified
basis: The review read main at 3715da1. Commit 7e75da6 (Gate 2 revision) already moved BOTH nodes to ARTIFICIALLY_COUPLED, reached independently from the drug-target catalog rather than from IL11. Current node_classification.tsv shows E_LIF, E_GP130_STAT3 and E_CD98_CD9 all ARTIFICIALLY_COUPLED / MERGES_DISTINCT_TARGET_CLASSES. The recommendation is correct and is not new work.
what_would_change_it: Nothing. Recorded so the convergence of two independent routes to the same verdict is on the record.

claim: IL11 is a human-relevant non-LIF GP130/STAT3 activator, satisfying the stated reopening condition
basis: This is the strongest genuinely new evidence in the review. It supplies the biological ground the Gate 2 verdict lacked: Gate 2 argued from two catalog rows having different target_class, which is an argument about the model, not about endometrium. Primary human endometrial epithelial evidence for a second GP130 ligand is an argument about the biology. VERIFIED AGAINST THE PRIMARY SOURCE 2026-09-16; see deep_research_drug_targets_2026-09-16.primary-verification.tsv. Marwood et al. 2009 (Endocrinology, PMID 19213836) confirms convergence AND adds a dissociation the review did not report: 'IL-11 stimulated, whereas LIF had no effect on the adhesion of trophoblast to endometrial epithelial cells'. Because that dissociation is DOWNSTREAM of both STAT3 and ITGA2, the review's own proposed convergent-only motif is necessary but NOT SUFFICIENT to represent the evidence. Promoted as REF-072 / LIT-IL11-001 / EDGE-052.
what_would_change_it: Full-text verification of the cited primary study; currently accepted on the review's report of it.

claim: Promote X_IL11 as a high-priority evaluation variant
basis: Direction accepted, staged IMPLEMENTATION rejected. The staged candidate_nodes.tsv gives X_IL11 logic_hint = S_DECIDUALIZED. Measured: that variant takes distinct Boolean functions 35 -> 36 and puts X_IL11 INSIDE the six-member decidual alias class, making it seven. X_IL11 as an independent free ligand gives 35 -> 37 and creates no new alias. The staged hint buys the LIF/STAT3 split at the cost of enlarging the class Gate 3a exists to break.
what_would_change_it: A determinant for maternal IL11 availability that is not S_DECIDUALIZED. Until one exists, admissible only as a free-input evaluation variant, never as canonical.

claim: Separate E_LIFR and E_IL11RA Boolean nodes are not immediately required
basis: Agrees with local parsimony rules and with §3.8 of docs/v05_plan_review.md. Receptor states earn admission only when receptor-specific blockade or expression is to be measured.
what_would_change_it: A design that measures receptor-level engagement.

claim: E_CD98_CD9 should leave the LIF/STAT3 alias class; hCG, E2 and EGF induce it
basis: Accepted, and local measurement raises its priority above the review's own ranking. Wiring E_CD98_CD9 to IN_HCG or IN_EMBRYO_CONDITIONED_SIGNAL -- both DECLARED IN v0.4 AND READ BY NO RULE -- takes 35 -> 36 distinct functions with NO new node and NO new alias. It is the cheapest real structural gain available in the model, and LIT-CD98-001 already records the inducer. VERIFIED AGAINST THE PRIMARY SOURCE 2026-09-16; see deep_research_drug_targets_2026-09-16.primary-verification.tsv. Dominguez et al. 2010 (PLOS One) -- already registered as REF-008 -- CORRECTS THIS ROW'S OWN EARLIER REASONING and the matching rationale in config/coupling_adjudication.tsv. CD98 is induced by hCG, 17-beta-estradiol, LIF AND EGF: LIF IS among the named inducers, so the defect is INCOMPLETENESS, not misattribution. REF-008's key_use field already recorded all four. The evidenced inducer for a variant is IN_HCG, NOT a generic embryo-conditioned signal; the structural probe cannot discriminate them, so evidence alone decides. Promoted as EDGE-051.
what_would_change_it: Nothing blocking. This is curation of an edge the evidence register already states, not invented topology.

claim: IN_cAMP = S_PKA should be reopened; human ESC evidence shows an EPAC/RAP1 arm
basis: The evidence claim is accepted and is a genuine catch: the Gate 2 rationale for IN_cAMP/S_PKA named "evidence that a cAMP effector other than PKA carries part of the decidual response" as its own reopening condition, and the review supplies it. The proposed node is measured inert: S_EPAC_RAP1 = IN_cAMP gives 35 -> 35 and ENLARGES the cAMP class to three. As an independent free variable it gives 35 -> 36 and still breaks no alias. VERIFIED AGAINST THE PRIMARY SOURCE 2026-09-16; see deep_research_drug_targets_2026-09-16.primary-verification.tsv. Kusama et al. 2013 (Placenta, PMID 23352189) confirms the second cAMP arm and shows it is COOPERATIVE: the EPAC-selective analogue is inert alone and only potentiates PKA, while EPAC1/EPAC2/RAP1 knockdown inhibits the PKA-driven response. Promoted as REF-073 / LIT-CAMP-001, and the IN_cAMP / S_PKA coupling verdict is changed to ARTIFICIALLY_COUPLED with NO node added.
what_would_change_it: A determinant for EPAC/RAP1 activity distinct from cAMP exposure. Recorded as a staged candidate; the adjudication for IN_cAMP/S_PKA is amended from BIOLOGICALLY_COLLAPSED to note the abstraction is deliberate rather than an equivalence claim.

claim: Promote S_BMP_SMAD; BMP2 abundance and BMPR/pSMAD activity are experimentally separable
basis: The biology is well evidenced and the separability claim is accepted. The staged node is measured INERT: candidate_nodes.tsv gives S_BMP_SMAD logic_hint = S_BMP2, which yields 35 -> 35 distinct functions and enlarges the E_IHH class from five to six. The full staged chain BMP2 -> SMAD -> WNT4 -> FOXO1, all pass-through, also yields 35 -> 35 and an eight-member class. Tested under the most favourable condition -- after the stromal channel is repaired -- it STILL adds nothing: 41 -> 41 with a new S_BMP2 = S_BMP_SMAD alias.
what_would_change_it: A determinant for BMP pathway activity that is not BMP2 abundance -- receptor availability, an antagonist, or cAMP-dependence. Without one the node is a relabelling.

claim: The BMP chain gives a route for breaking the PGR/IHH/NR2F2/BMP2 alias
basis: Measured false. The E_IHH alias is caused UPSTREAM: E_IHH = E_PGR = S_PGR = IN_PROGESTIN and not IN_MIFEPRISTONE. No node added downstream of S_BMP2 touches it, in any variant tested. What does break it is a determinant at the RECEIVING end: giving S_NR2F2 an epithelial-competence conjunct splits the class into three (35 -> 38, no new alias). The review's remedy is aimed at the wrong end of the relay. CORRECTED 2026-09-16 after challenge: the earlier note here proposed a free S_NR2F2 epithelial-competence input. That is WITHDRAWN. A free competence bit has no biological semantics, no measurement and no perturbation; it was reverse-engineered from the partition, which is the error this whole review exists to avoid. The structural result stands (a determinant at the receiving end is what breaks the class); the proposed variable does not. See DTR026.
what_would_change_it: Nothing about the BMP chain. The repair belongs at the IHH RECEPTION step, and no admissible representation of it is yet available -- see DTR026.

claim: E_ITGAVB3_5 is functionally vacuous and must be de-aliased before anti-integrin experiments are scored
basis: Independently established locally and more strongly than the review states: the E_ITGAVB3_5 conjunct in X_ADHESION_ROUTE_SPP1 is absorbed in ALL 2^19 free-variable assignments, enumerated and pinned by tests/unit/test_coupling_adjudication.py. The review's practical conclusion -- do not run an expensive integrin arm against a model that cannot represent integrin blockade -- is endorsed.
what_would_change_it: The de-aliasing itself. Measured: giving E_ITGAVB3_5 any determinant outside the secretory program takes 35 -> 37 and splits it out of the nine-member class.

claim: Keep expression source, free ligand and receptor as separate layers; IN_ANTI_SPP1 correctly acts at the free-ligand layer
basis: Agrees with the committed encoding and with LIT-SPP1-001. X_SPP1_LUMEN_FREE already carries the free-ligand layer and IN_ANTI_SPP1 already acts there. No change required.
what_would_change_it: Nothing.

claim: PC6 enzyme and cleaved-DAG1 product must not be one state
basis: Accepted, and locally this is the highest-leverage single separation measured. Giving E_PC6 a determinant outside the secretory program breaks TWO classes at once -- {E_PC6, E_DAG1_CLEAVED} out of the nine-member secretory class, AND E_DAG1_FULL out of the barrier trio, because E_DAG1_FULL = not E_PC6 propagates it -- for 35 -> 38 distinct functions. No other single edit tested reaches 38. VERIFIED AGAINST THE PRIMARY SOURCE 2026-09-16; see deep_research_drug_targets_2026-09-16.primary-verification.tsv. Heng et al. 2015 (FASEB J, PMID 26077903) -- already registered as REF-011 -- confirms the dissociation by CLEAVAGE-SITE MUTANT, which changes the product while leaving the enzyme intact. This CORRECTS TI009: the determinant belongs on the PRODUCT (E_DAG1_CLEAVED), not on the enzyme, because PC6 is reported upregulated specifically at receptivity, consistent with its current encoding. Promoted as LIT-PC6-002.
what_would_change_it: A BIOLOGICAL determinant for PC6 activity distinct from the secretory program. None is currently in the repository; the probe used an intervention input, which is not evidence and must not be built as one.

claim: Replace E_MUC1_SLEX with a scaffold-agnostic E_GLYCOSYLATION_PROGRAM -> E_SLEX_SURFACE decomposition
basis: The biological argument is accepted: MUC1 abundance cannot stand in for the adhesive glycoform, and FUT3/ST3GAL3 machinery is a distinct level. But replacing a committed node is a larger move than adding candidates, and the staged pair already exists with logic_hint E_GLYCOSYLATION_PROGRAM -> E_SLEX_SURFACE, which is another pass-through pair and will be inert for the same reason as DTR007 unless the program has a determinant of its own.
what_would_change_it: A determinant for the glycosylation program. Until then, candidate layer only; E_MUC1_SLEX stays and its forced complementarity with E_MUC1_BARRIER remains recorded as a caveat.

claim: Perturb mechanics as mechanics; do not use a YAP/TAZ compound as a stiffness surrogate
basis: Accepted without reservation and consistent with the standing continuous_spatial adjudication in results_reproducibility_matrix.tsv. Note one local distinction the review does not draw: the mechanical READOUTS are out of the Boolean formalism, the mechanical TARGET is not -- a TAZ-directed agent's effect on attachment fraction is expressible, which is why S_TAZ_ECM is ARTIFICIALLY_COUPLED rather than excused by the formalism decision.
what_would_change_it: Nothing.

claim: Replace the interface relay drug-target entries with STRUCTURAL_NODE_NOT_A_TARGET records
basis: No X_*_RELAY node has any row in drug_target_catalog.tsv. There is nothing to replace. The recommendation rests on a misreading of the catalog. The underlying principle -- relays are hand-set uncertainty, not targets -- is already the committed position and is recorded in config/coupling_adjudication.tsv.
what_would_change_it: Nothing. Recorded to prevent a future round acting on the false premise.

claim: Keep the anti-SPP1 fourth arm provisional; it should not be inherited from planned_design.yaml
basis: Already enforced in code at commit 7e75da6: planned_design.yaml declares role = as_declared_plan_baseline_not_a_prospective_selection, design_alias.load_plan refuses any other value, and three tests hold it including one that repurposes the file in a sandbox and requires refusal.
what_would_change_it: Nothing.

claim: Split PRL and IGFBP1 as outputs; do not drug either marker
basis: Accepted; already the local position from OM-016 and Gate 2. Neither node is in the drug catalog, so the "do not drug them" recommendation is already satisfied. One local measurement to carry forward: routing PRL through an intermediate is INERT at the fixed point (35 -> 35, class grows to seven), which independently confirms what results_reproducibility_matrix.md already recorded -- the ordering claim lives only in the transient, so no fixed-point partition can test it.
what_would_change_it: Nothing for the split itself. See DTR017 for the new part.

claim: IGFBP1 may itself signal through an RGD/integrin-dependent route, so "pure marker" status may be incomplete
basis: Genuinely new and worth staging. If IGFBP1 has an outgoing functional edge it is not a passive reporter, which would affect both the Gate 3a repair and the treatment of OUT_STROMAL_DECIDUALIZED. Staged, not promoted: a functional feedback edge from a calibration-role readout would need its own leakage analysis before it could enter any model used to interpret that readout. VERIFIED AGAINST THE PRIMARY SOURCE 2026-09-16; see deep_research_drug_targets_2026-09-16.primary-verification.tsv. Sakai et al. 2008 (Mol Hum Reprod, PMID 18583428) confirms the outgoing route: recombinant IGFBP-1 induces decidualization WITHOUT MPA or E2 and raises PRL, anti-alpha5beta1 blocks binding, RGD peptide blocks the effect and is inert alone. The biology is supported; the ENCODING remains gated on leakage analysis and on the fact that the edge would make the network cyclic. Promoted as REF-074 / LIT-IGFBP1-001 / EDGE-053 at tier=unresolved.
what_would_change_it: Full-text verification, and an explicit leakage control for using a measured readout as a causal node.

claim: IL11 and LIF both increase adhesion via STAT3 but produce distinguishable phenotypes; alpha2beta1 blockade reduced LIF-induced collagen-IV adhesion
basis: The new review CORROBORATES the 2026-09-11 rejection of DRE009 rather than overturning it. Its own table records alpha2beta1 blockade against the LIF-induced response, not the IL11-induced one. By biological level: IL11 -> STAT3 supported; IL11 -> ITGA2 abundance supported; IL11 -> ACTIVE alpha2beta1 adhesive receptor NOT established; LIF-dependent alpha2beta1 function supported; IL11-specific alpha2beta1 necessity NOT established. E_ITGA2B1 is staged as role=adhesive_receptor, measurable surface ITGA2/ITGB1, so the abundance evidence does not reach the modelled state.
what_would_change_it: Evidence of alpha2beta1 ACTIVITY or functional necessity under IL11 specifically. DRE009 stands, including its 2026-09-14 clarification that redefining E_ITGA2B1 to an abundance state requires a new adjudication and may never be inferred from that row.

claim: drug_target_catalog.tsv should not be an authority for deciding whether two nodes may be collapsed
basis: The principle is accepted and is already respected in one direction: the Gate 2 invariant runs ONLY as MERGES_DISTINCT_TARGET_CLASSES -> ARTIFICIALLY_COUPLED. It never infers collapse from absence, and NOT_A_CATALOGUED_TARGET forces nothing. The correction is that the review understates a real defect it is adjacent to: see DTR020.
what_would_change_it: Nothing on the principle.

claim: (local finding, not in the review) target_class is free text with near-unique values, so the invariant's behaviour depends on naming granularity
basis: 24 distinct target_class values across 34 rows, 17 of them appearing exactly once. The invariant fired on three of the five multi-target classes and not on the other two -- and what protected the barrier trio was that somebody happened to give PODXL, DAG1 and MUC1 the SAME coarse label anti_adhesive_surface, while adhesive_effector lumps a glycoform, a transmembrane complex and a junction protein. The invariant is therefore partly an artefact of naming granularity. This is the single most important catalog defect found.
what_would_change_it: A closed, documented target_class vocabulary defined by biological LEVEL (ligand / receptor / pathway / protease / glycan / TF / ECM / mechanical / state / readout), with the Gate 2 invariant re-derived against it and every changed verdict surfaced individually.

claim: (local finding) execution_status=executable is applied to nodes that are states or products, not intervention targets
basis: X_MECHANICAL_PERMISSIVE_ECM is model_role=latent_state and derived; E_DAG1_CLEAVED is a cleavage PRODUCT (you perturb the protease); E_MUC1_SLEX is a glycoform reachable only via machinery absent from the model; E_ESTROGENIC_PROLIFERATION is a derived proliferative state; E_KLF12_HIGH is genetic-only and the repository's own scRNA work declined to activate any prior; S_FGF_MITOGENIC is derived (not S_HAND2). All six are marked executable.
what_would_change_it: Demoting them is a SCIENTIFIC change, not metadata maintenance: it removes their catalog ground for ARTIFICIALLY_COUPLED. Their verdicts should NOT revert, because the node dictionary's own measurement_proxies and model_role separate them independently of any catalog. See DTR022.

claim: (local finding) the node dictionary already supplies a non-druggability separability axis, stronger than target_class
basis: Every multi-member alias class merges nodes with distinct measurement_proxies, and every class except the barrier trio also merges distinct model_role. E_LIF proxy "LIF expression or secretion" role attachment_gate is one bit with E_GP130_STAT3 proxy "pSTAT3 or target-program activity" role pathway_gate. E_SPP1_EXPR role ligand_source is one bit with E_ITGAVB3_5 role adhesion_receptor -- a ligand and its own receptor. This is internal to the model, needs no catalog, and cannot be gamed by drug availability.
what_would_change_it: Nothing blocking. Proposed as a REPORTED axis, never verdict-forcing: role-distinctness alone must not force ARTIFICIALLY_COUPLED, or E_PAEP (readout) against E_SECRETORY_STATE (state) would fire, which §8 of the brief and the current adjudication both decline.

claim: (local finding) PERT-003 targets the string "E_LIF/E_GP130_STAT3" as one target
basis: The conflation the review flags in the drug catalog is also present, and more literally, in context/literature/perturbations.tsv: PERT-003 "LIF or LIFR blockade" has target "E_LIF/E_GP130_STAT3", and PERT-004 "STAT3 inhibition" targets E_GP130_STAT3;S_STAT3. Ligand neutralisation, receptor blockade and pathway inhibition are three interventions in two rows.
what_would_change_it: Splitting PERT-003 into ligand-level and receptor-level rows. Not done here: perturbations.tsv is a canonical literature table and this review layer does not modify canonical tables.

claim: The LIF/IL11/STAT3 package is the highest-value prospective experiment
basis: Accepted as the leading candidate on biology. Local structural measurement reorders what should be REPAIRED first, which is a different question: CD98 rewiring is the cheapest structural gain (no new node), and the combined package of CD98 rewire + independent IL11 + S_NR2F2 competence reaches 35 -> 41 distinct functions for two new nodes, breaking the GP130 class into three and the IHH class into three.
what_would_change_it: See the topology-implications table for the ranked package.

claim: The catalog schema should be replaced wholesale with a ~30-field mechanism-perturbation schema
basis: The proposed schema is sound and most of its fields are genuinely needed. Deferred rather than accepted because drug_target_catalog.tsv is now consumed by executable code (reporting/coupling.py) and a schema replacement would be a breaking change to a Gate 2 input. It should follow DTR020, not precede it: fix the vocabulary that affects adjudication first, then widen the schema.
what_would_change_it: DTR020 landing first.

claim: What biologically grounded state, if any, supplies the missing determinant at the NR2F2 receiving step
basis: Four representations examined. (1) A free S_NR2F2 competence input: REJECTED -- invented latent variable, no semantics, no measurement, no perturbation. (2) S_NR2F2_ACTIVITY, splitting abundance from transcriptional activity: REJECTED -- the node's own node_dictionary measurement_proxies already read 'expression or regulon activity', so this is a second abstraction over one quantity with no independent determinant, and no local evidence separates them. (3) A stromal IHH/PTCH/SMO/GLI reception state: BEST GROUNDED and still not promotable -- docs/adoc_dt_implementation_spec.md:284 names the chain verbatim 'IHH-PTCH-SMO-GLI-NR2F2-HAND2-BMP2-WNT4', so it is curation not invention; PTCH1 and GLI1 are themselves HH target genes and are the canonical pathway-activity readout; SMO antagonists are a specific, well-characterised perturbation class. But MEASURED: as a pass-through it is INERT (35 -> 35, and it grows the E_IHH class from five to six -- the S_BMP_SMAD failure mode one level up), and with a competence conjunct it reaches 38 while leaving a new S_HH_RECEPTION = S_NR2F2 alias, i.e. it RELOCATES the same unknown rather than resolving it. Evidence is mouse uterine conditional knockout (REF-025 Franco 2010, REF-026 Kurihara 2007) and LIT-IHH-001 itself records that human attachment causality is partly transferred from mouse genetics. (4) No new node: ADOPTED. VERIFIED AGAINST THE PRIMARY SOURCE 2026-09-16; see deep_research_drug_targets_2026-09-16.primary-verification.tsv. Kurihara et al. 2007 is held locally as PDF-033 with full_text_inspected=yes, confirming the mouse Ihh -> COUP-TFII -> BMP2 chain and the BMP2 add-back rescue. NO human compartment-specific causal evidence was found. The blocking condition is TIGHTENED accordingly -- see what_would_change_it. HUMAN EVIDENCE LOCATED AND REGISTERED 2026-09-16 after challenge: REF-075 / LIT-IHH-002. It does not change the decision -- still no new node -- because it is expression and pharmacological response, not a necessity test, and because a pass-through S_HH_RECEPTION is measured inert (35 -> 35) regardless of how well evidenced the state is. It does narrow the gap and it does partially close the species flag LIT-IHH-001 carries.
what_would_change_it: CORRECTED TWICE. An earlier draft framed this as evidence that 'may not exist' -- too pessimistic. A second draft said human EXPRESSION exists but cited nothing, which left a positive claim about the literature untraceable in a canonical table. Both are now fixed: REF-075 (Wei et al. 2010, JCEM 95:5330, PMID 20881264) is registered, and it is stronger than 'expression' -- human endometrium IN VIVO, compartment-resolved across epithelium AND stroma, measuring IHH, PTCH1, SMO, GLI1 and GLI2 across the cycle, with the selective PR modulator CDB-2914 raising IHH 5.2-fold and GLI1 3.6-fold. GLI1 is the canonical pathway-ACTIVITY readout, so human Hedgehog OUTPUT is already known to be progestin-responsive, which supports the model's E_PGR -> E_IHH edge. WHAT REMAINS MISSING IS NARROWER THAN BEFORE: a NECESSITY test -- an SMO antagonist or PTCH1/GLI knockdown in human endometrial stroma read out on NR2F2 or HAND2. Note NR2F2 was not among REF-075's measured targets, so even the correlative human link from Hedgehog output to NR2F2 is untested. Recorded canonically as LIT-IHH-002 and GAP-014.

claim: NR2F2's documented repression of epithelial estrogenic proliferation should be wired as a direct edge
basis: LIT-IHH-001's observation field does state that the relay 'suppresses nonreceptive epithelial proliferation', and NR2F2 has only one out-edge in the model (to S_BMP2), so this looked like an unwired documented consequence of the same shape as the CD98/hCG finding. It is not. The arm is ALREADY represented, through S_HAND2 -> S_FGF_MITOGENIC -> E_ESTROGENIC_PROLIFERATION. Adding a second, direct NR2F2 repression edge is measured to make the model WORSE: 35 -> 34 distinct Boolean functions, creating a five-member alias that merges E_LIF, E_GP130_STAT3, E_CD98_CD9, E_RECEPTIVE_SURFACE and OUT_EPITHELIAL_RECEPTIVE. It absorbs the IN_HAND2_LOSS sensitivity and collapses the epithelial receptive axis.
what_would_change_it: Evidence that NR2F2 restrains epithelial ER activity by a route INDEPENDENT of HAND2, which would need its own node rather than an edge onto the existing one.

source_section: local finding, not in the review
claim: S_FGF_MITOGENIC is a fifth absorbed conjunct, absent from the Gate 2 enumeration of four
basis: Found while testing DTR027. S_FGF_MITOGENIC = not S_HAND2, so the conjunction 'S_FGF_MITOGENIC and not S_HAND2' in E_ESTROGENIC_PROLIFERATION reduces to 'not S_HAND2' and the FGF intermediate contributes nothing. Same class as the four already enumerated and pinned (E_PAEP, S_PRL/S_IGFBP1, E_ITGAVB3_5, S_TAZ_ECM). Consequence: the stroma-to-epithelium relay's own intermediate is vacuous, so HAND2 loss and an FGF9-level perturbation are one intervention, and the review's own recommendation to probe FGF9 separately from HAND2 has no model image.
what_would_change_it: Adding S_FGF_MITOGENIC to the absorption test set in tests/unit/test_coupling_adjudication.py, and a determinant for FGF9 beyond 'not S_HAND2'.
